name: kraken-mcp
description: Kraken (spot) (trading): list_markets, get_ticker, get_candles. Every tool maps to a documented endp

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every tradable pair (altname such as XBTUSD, wsname XBT/USD, Kraken base/quote asset codes such as XXBT/ZUSD); sorted and paged locally; `query` is a case-insensitive substring of the pair names.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: symbol is a pair altname such as XBTUSD or ETHEUR (list_markets). volume is the rolling 24h base volume (v[1]).

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: interval: 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d, 1w, 15d. Kraken answers up to 720 candles whatever is asked; the newest `limit` are returned (oldest first).
